1-001.note: 1.1 notes now state the rule with its condition: line of sight perpendicular to the scale at the reading, eye directly above a flat ruler, level with a vertical scale or meniscus. 1.2.5 'read at eye level' changed to 'read with the eye directly above the mark, so the line of sight is perpendicular to the scale'. P01 Q8 stem now 'when reading a scale' and option B 'Read with the line of sight perpendicular to the scale'; explanation updated.

1-002.note: ITEM 106 MISCON stem rewritten neutrally (seedlings in 0, 1, 2, 3 % salt, height recorded after 7 days); learner claims height is independent and must judge whether that is right. Answer and guidance updated; tariff, subtype and labels unchanged.

1-003.note: P01 Q1 now describes the investigation neutrally (soaked 0/2/4/8 h, kept at 25 °C, germination counted after 5 days); distractors are the dependent variable and two controlled variables (temperature, seed variety).

1-004.note: 1.2.3 now says points on a further curve may be marked with vertical crosses (+), shown in the key.

1-005.note: Key-points table row and 1.2.1 sentence now read 'Controlled (constant) variable(s)'.

1-006.note: Standard form definition replaced: the power shows how many places the decimal point has moved, positive for large numbers, negative for numbers smaller than 1.
